snippet.title: Version 5.8 "Sunspray Summer Resort" Trailer | Genshin Impact #NewVersion #Trailer #GenshinImpact
snippet.description:
Natlan's a hot place all year round. If you put your mind to it, every day can be considered a summer vacation.
So why not set aside your commissions, Paimon's treats, stories of the ancient dragons' civilization, visitors from Nod-Krai, as well as a letter from the Grand Master...
...and just enjoy the free food, lodgings, and attractions?

VA:
Paimon — Anonymous
Mualani — Cassandra Lee Morris
Chasca — Lauren Amante

Ineffa — Angelina Danielle Cama
Aino — Annabel Brook
Xilonen — Elizabeth Dean
Sandrone, Fatui Harbinger. Codename: "Marionette" — Deneen Melody
Yelan — Laura Post
